note: Every dataset is pinned to an immutable revision. scripts/fetch.ts downloads and sha256-verifies everything listed here; datasets/select.ts derives the pre-registered subsets in datasets/subsets/ deterministically from the committed seeds. Downloaded payloads live in datasets/files/ and are never committed.

fatura.name: FATURA (synthetic invoices, 50 layouts)
fatura.selection: for each of the 50 templates, seeded shuffle of that template's test-split instances, take 2 → 100 docs
fatura.groundTruth: Annotations/Original_Format/<id>.json, mapped to the canonical invoice schema by datasets/select.ts (mapping rules in docs/methodology.md); derived GT committed under datasets/gt/fatura/

sroie.name: SROIE (ICDAR 2019 scanned receipts, key information task)
sroie.license: SROIE competition terms — images are script-downloaded only and NEVER committed to this repo; derived ground truth is also kept out of the repo and re-derived by scripts/fetch.ts
sroie.universe: all annotated samples in samples.json (712 receipts)
sroie.selection: seeded shuffle of the sorted filename list, take 100
sroie.groundTruth: {company, date, address, total} per sample from samples.json (NOT committed; re-derived at fetch time)

cord.name: CORD-v2 (Indonesian retail receipts)
cord.universe: the full official test split (100 receipts) — no sampling
cord.selection: all 100, ids = row index in the official test parquet
cord.groundTruth: gt_parse from the ground_truth column, mapped to items + totals (merchant/date are blurred in CORD-v2 and never scored); derived GT committed under datasets/gt/cord/

fintabnet.name: FinTabNet (financial report tables), OTSL/HTML conversion by the IBM Docling team
fintabnet.license: Derived from IBM FinTabNet (CDLA-Permissive-1.0); conversion published by the Docling project
fintabnet.selection: seeded shuffle of the sorted (filename, imgid) list, take 100
fintabnet.groundTruth: the dataset's original FinTabNet HTML structure tokens + cell content, materialized as ground-truth HTML; committed under datasets/gt/fintabnet/

bankstatemently.name: Bankstatemently Open Benchmark (synthetic bank/credit-card statements)
bankstatemently.universe: the 5 statements published so far (bsb-001..bsb-005; bsb-006..bsb-015 are 'coming soon' upstream)
bankstatemently.groundTruth: held server-side by Bankstatemently; scored via POST https://api.bankstatemently.com/v1/benchmark/evaluate (their responses cached verbatim in results/raw/)
